headline: EPS up from a year ago and flat on the prior quarter
summary_short: Bridgestone reported EPS of ¥90.84, up 37.1% y/y from ¥66.27 and flat q/q versus ¥90.93.
summary_long: EPS is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed. Earlier coverage of the first half showed adjusted operating profit of ¥280.9B, but no release for this quarter was found.
